$comment: Foreground/background pairs the app defines itself, checked against WCAG in CI.
CONTEXT section 4.1: text at least 4.5:1, UI components at least 3:1.
'foreground' and 'background' are x:Key names of <Color> or <SolidColorBrush>
resources declared in any XAML under src/. Add a pair for every combination the
app renders, in every theme, as soon as a palette exists.
The app currently uses stock WinUI theme brushes, which Microsoft already
validates, so there is nothing app-defined to check yet.
